# alert-rule-lint

Lint Prometheus alerting and recording rule files for structural compliance and team policies (labels, annotations, durations, naming).

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): Installation, usage, CLI, and linting rules.
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): The internal pipeline and safety measures.
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): Test suite coverage.
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): Threat model and safety limits.
